content.outro: The light was still burning when the boat came back for them.
content.premise: The sea took Greyhithe's lower pans a generation ago and the community went with them. The light on the headland has burned every night since. Four are put ashore to find out who is keeping it lit.
content.theme: A cliffside salt works and the abbey that owned it, abandoned to the sea, with one light still burning on the headland.
content.title: The Saltworks at Greyhithe
